translations.definition: (ерийн хүндэтгэлгүй үг хэллэг) найрсагаар захиран тушааж буйг илэрхийлдэг төгсгөх нөхцөл.

(cách nói hạ thấp thông thường) Vĩ tố kết thúc câu thể hiện sự ra lệnh một cách thân mật.
(ใช้ในการลดระดับธรรมดาและเป็นทางการ)วิภัตติปัจจัยลงท้ายประโยคที่แสดงการสั่งอย่างสนิทสนม
(dalam bentuk rendah) kata penutup final  yang menyatakan perintah dengan akrab
(фамильярный стиль) Финитное окончание, указывающее на дружеское повеление.
(formal, moderately addressee-lowering) A sentence-final ending used when giving an order in a friendly manner.
(等称) 親しみをこめて命令する意を表す「終結語尾」。
(forme non honorifique modérée) Terminaison finale pour donner un ordre de manière affectueuse.
(TRATAMIENTO DE MODESTIA ORDINARIA) Desinencia de terminación que se usa cuando se manda de forma íntima.

examples: 잠깐 나갔다 올 테니 먼저 식사 들게나.

for path in sorted((ROOT/'.direnv/dictionary-restoration/2026-09').glob('*.json')):

assert {e['headword'] for e in entries.values()}==heads,'All selected lexical/boundary heads must exist; do not invent missing dictionary entries'

packed=gzip.compress((json.dumps(closure,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode(),mtime=0);CLOSURE.write_bytes(packed)

for ordinal,(surface,lemma) in enumerate([('가게나','가다'),('살게나','살다'),('먹게나','먹다'),('듣게나','듣다'),('돕게나','돕다'),('짓게나','짓다'),('낫게나','낫다'),('푸게나','푸다'),('공부하게나','공부하다')],1):
 case('friendly-command-gena-regular-boundary-'+str(ordinal),surface,[lemma],['predicate'],['게나'],['ending'],'required','Declared synthetic structural proposal: consonant-initial 게나 follows the regular verb stem; lexical homonyms and other possible readings stay unjudged. This is not a quoted corpus or dictionary example.')
for ordinal,(surface,lemma) in enumerate([('먹으시게나','먹다'),('사시게나','살다'),('도우시게나','돕다')],1):
 case('friendly-command-gena-honorific-'+str(ordinal),surface,[lemma],['predicate'],['시','게나'],['prefinal','ending'],'required','Declared synthetic verb-plus-honorific proposal, using the original explicit -으시- note. Adjective/copula predicates after honorifics and social/register interpretation remain unjudged.')
for ordinal,(surface,lemma) in enumerate([('들게나','듣다'),('도우게나','돕다'),('지으게나','짓다'),('사게나','살다'),('퍼게나','푸다')],1):

Other lexical hypotheses for the surface remain unjudged.')
case('friendly-command-gena-bare-copula', '학생이게나',['학생','이다'],['nominal','copula'],['게나'],['ending'],'forbidden','The original bare attachment note lists verbs; this exact nominal plus bare copula path does not acquire the command ending. case('friendly-command-gena-derived-adjective', '학생답게나',['학생'],['nominal'],['답다','게나'],['suffix','ending'],'forbidden','The correctly consonant-inflected known 답다 derivation retains its nominal-plus-suffix shape and cannot borrow the bare verb command. suite=dict(schema_version=1,review_status='independently authored finite structural proposals before runtime; contextual and Korean review pending',sources={source:owner['url']},cases=cases)
